svg.text: The double-slit experiment: interaction changes the outcome, attention does not

g.text: Detector at the slits, nobody watching
No consciousness required, in either row
A simple electronic detector at the slits destroys the interference pattern with nobody in the room.
Nature responds to physical interaction that records which-path information, not to a mind paying attention.
“Nature does not know what you are looking at” Richard Feynman, The Feynman Lectures on Physics
